title: Choosing an interface versus extending a class
answer: Use an interface when you want to express a capability or role that many unrelated classes can implement and when multiple contracts may be combined. Extend a class when the subtype truly belongs to that base hierarchy and should inherit shared state, construction rules, or protected behavior. A concrete class can often do both.
